Name: Sensible Gender Symbols
Author: Laurazepan
Description:
[center][/center][left][/left][font=Verdana][center][size=4][font=Tahoma]﻿[/font][font=Tahoma]﻿In the character creations screen this game uses the Mars ([b]♂[/b]) and Venus ([b]♀[/b]) symbols to represent gender.
These symbols are outdated and confusing. A lot of people (including myself) get them mixed up all the time.
In Stardew Valley gender is unfortunately quite important and a lot of elements (mostly dialog) are affected by your choice.
You probably also know the feeling when you join a new dating app and suddenly see the wrong gender pop up.

This mod is here to prevent this from ever happening again.[/font][font=Tahoma]

[b]SGS [/b]uses vanilla graphics to replace the gender symbols with more sensible, modern ones.[/font][/size][/center]




[size=3][b]Installation Guide:[/b][/size]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]to your game folder (duh)
﻿2. Add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to your mod folder
﻿3. Extract this mod's download and drag "[CP] SensibleGenderSymbols" to your mod folder
﻿4. [i]Experience Tranquility[/i]



[size=3][b]FAQ:[/b][/size]

"﻿I already messed up my character's gender, will this mod help?"
﻿Not at all. However the Wizard offers a cheap SRS you can use.
﻿"Isn't it super transphobic to equate gender with what's in your pants?"
﻿ ﻿Well, uh, yeah kinda. However that certainly wasn't the goal. Now there's new and improved versions that indicate your gender in other ways.
﻿ ﻿﻿There's also a trans version. See the new screenshots.
